task: Read-only diagnosis of formal5852 Node22 reconnect service failure

established.fact: First installation, enrollment, registration and online observation succeeded before the reconnect assertion.
The failed assertion at acceptance line139 follows restartLocal, not beginLocal.
restart() selects Node again, rewrites/restarts the service using service install, then waits online. The failed service command prevents this second waitOnline from running.
installService writes the intended plist, ignores every bootout rejection, then immediately runs bootstrap once.
The captured installer stderr reports launchctl bootstrap Bootstrap failed:5 Input/output error; installer process exitCode is1. This does not establish launchctl's numeric exit code independently.
The old daemon's log already contains daemon stopped before fixture catch captured logs and before fixture finally's cleanup bootout.
Gateway404 is explicitly followed by long-poll fallback and occurred while the first installation became online; it is not the failing command.
The lastStatus field is the previously saved status output, not a successful new post-bootstrap observation.
established.source: acceptance execute lines105-109 and restart command flow

established.fact: The CLI and local RPC expose no daemon service restart or daemon.restart command. Internal restartService is used from device commands and auto-update maintenance, using SIGUSR2, normal daemon.stop and exit1.
The installService transition itself has no existing service.test command-state regression; installer reconnect test mocks the service-install command as successful.

causeClassification.provenFailureBoundary: Repeated service installation at reconnect: bootout then bootstrap
causeClassification.provenProductRobustnessGap: All bootout errors are discarded, so absence, rejection and incomplete teardown are not distinguishable from retained evidence.
notEstablished: Whether the actual bootout failed and its error was ignored
Whether bootout succeeded while launchd registration removal was not yet complete
Whether another launchd domain/definition/system error produced this EIO5
Whether this is a new5852 regression rather than a pre-existing path
notCausesEstablishedByThisEvidence: No Node discovery or npm install failure in this attempt
No enrollment failure in this attempt
No waitOnline deadline expiration: the second waitOnline is not reached

replacementAssessment.decision: Not justified as a drop-in fix
replacementAssessment.reason: Potentially bypasses normal daemon stop and preserves the already loaded definition, losing intended Node/server/data-dir/flags rewrite semantics. This source review did not execute launchctl.
CLI onDrained exits0 while the plist restarts on unsuccessful exit; drain does not promise restart.
Normal cleanup exists, but there is no local RPC/CLI contract for it; must preserve selected config and prove replacement generation before an old online PID could satisfy waitOnline.

replacementAssessment.option: Compare only on-disk plist then signal
replacementAssessment.reason: Disk bytes alone do not prove the active launchd registration uses the same definition.
Would hide distinct errors and is not supported by a proven transient state.
The failing bootstrap command precedes the second online polling loop.

minimalNextEvidence.entry: Existing isolated macOS acceptance sequence: first install -> online -> restartLocal -> online assertion, with all assertions/timeout preserved.
closedProjection: validated service-target state category, if independently defined
restrictions: Do not record credential files, ambient launchctl output, full environment or secrets
Do not automatically retry or change bootstrap on this diagnostic step
Do not use launchctl print internal text keys as a stable API
A nonzero probe exit or an absent old PID alone is not proof that the service registration is absent
minimalNextEvidence.conditionalFix: If a stable unregistered predicate and actual teardown race are established, preserve intended definition updates, fail on real bootout errors, then perform one bounded state-confirmed bootstrap. The present review does not claim that fix is already causally established.

testDesignOnly: Production installService transition should distinguish first install confirmed absence from failed bootout; a real bootout error must not be silently followed by bootstrap.
A teardown-in-progress case must not bootstrap until an explicit registration-absence predicate is satisfied; deadline failure must retain the original cause.
A configuration change must still install the newly selected Node, entry, server, data-dir and flags.
A same-definition restart optimization, if later adopted, must prove a replacement process and preserve graceful stop; old online status is not sufficient.
Keep the actual macOS first install/reconnect, no re-enrollment and owner verification assertions unchanged.

limits.rootExternalLaunchctlDocumentationReview: Root separately reviewed the launchctl manual; this receipt establishes repository source and frozen-log facts only.
